days.title: Waterfront Relaxation and Village Charms
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Attersee Water Park
stops.detail: The Attersee Water Park combines beach and outdoor pool: a heated pool (26 °C), slides into the lake, a white-water channel, a geyser, massage jets and a waterfall.

stops.name: Unterach
stops.detail: A mix of magnificent villas from the turn of the century, Unterach has preserved its village character to this day.

stops.name: Höllengebirge
stops.detail: Lake Attersee lies between the Schafberg and the Höllengebirge.

stops.name: Gustav Klimt Themed Trail
stops.detail: Boat tours on Lake Attersee stop at attractions like the Gustav Klimt Themed Trail and various arts festivals.

stops.name: Wildholzweg
stops.detail: A few examples are the Ransonnet theme trail, the Wildholzweg, the Buchberg circular route at Lake Attersee, „The glass valley" trail, the pilgrimage route Josefweg, the Lake Attersee panoramic hike and the tour to the Reiserbauern mill.

stops.detail: At Weyregg Lido, you'll find a sunbathing lawn, a jetty, a children's area with a solar-heated pool, a floating island, and a café on the catamaran.

stops.name: Nixenfall

stops.name: Attersee-Traunsee Star Park
stops.detail: The Attersee-Traunsee Star Park – Austria's first Dark Sky Park – stands for the conscious use of light at night.
